svg.aria-label: Figure 6 — FlatRowStore packed chunk copied in 1,024-row pages into a stack-only RowRef ref struct for zero-allocation column reads
svg.text: Because RowRef is a ref struct, C# forbids escaping it past the foreach iteration — making buffer reuse memory-safe.
Look up column ordinals once before the loop (players.GetOrdinal("Score")); after warm-up, a full scan allocates 0 B.
